bridge.title: Four things I noticed

beats.title: 80,000 views on one reel. Your top tier is $1,000, once.
beats.text: Your reel from 3 October passed 80,000 views, another passed 37,000, and YouTube adds 13.6K subscribers and almost a million views. But Inner Disciple, your private mentorship, is a one-time $1,000 for lifetime access.

beats.title: You post daily. None of it points to the mentorship.
beats.text: 12 posts in 15 days, 60+ free lessons, and members on your site calling it “the only course you need”. But none of your last 12 captions mention Inner Prospects or Inner Disciple. The attention arrives and has nowhere to go.

beats.title: A private mentorship sold with a checkout button.
beats.text: Spots open once a quarter, but anyone can click through Whop and pay. Nobody is asked where they are or whether they're serious, and every lifetime member pays once while you and Halo review their trades for good.

beats.title: “I don't want to sell hard.” An application doesn't.
beats.text: It doesn't push anyone. It lets the serious ones raise their hand, and gives you and Halo a short call to choose who gets one of the quarterly spots. The price can match what the mentorship is worth.
beats.quote: “My goal is simple: pass down the precision I built from years of data collection.”

bridge.closing: So instead of explaining it, I built it. The page, the application, the emails and the ads, all below.

preCallEmails.subject: You're booked: here's what happens next
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is booked for {{call_time}}. The link is in your calendar invite.

Before we talk:
1. Keep the time free.
2. Have a few recent trades ready with your notes on why you took them.

One note: nobody on my team will ever ask you to pay through a DM. Payments only happen through the official links from this email address.

Talk soon,
Fearing

Hey {{first_name}},

Most traders see the manipulation and still get it wrong, because they don't know when it ends.

That's what the framework is for: Power of 3 for price, Quarterly Theory for time, one model instead of a pile of setups.

Good. Then you know the concepts.

Inner Disciple is for when knowing them isn't enough: your own journal, reviewed, until you trade the narrative and not the candle.

preCallEmails.subject: What we'll cover on the call
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

The call takes about 30 minutes:

1. Where you are now and what you've tried.
2. Where you want to be in a year.
3. How the program works, what it costs, and whether it fits you.

If it isn't a fit, we'll tell you. No pressure either way.

Fearing
